long_biography.plain_text:
Joop Punt approached his first cinema like a builder. Before opening Metro in Heerhugowaard, the Dutch property entrepreneur took friends to an Amsterdam screening and assigned them to measure the auditorium and seats. His design broke convention with a fireplace, dining area, airline seats and a bar offering views of the screen.

Punt also moved into property investment and redevelopment. Punt Beheer assembled offices, homes, shopping centres, hospitality venues and leisure properties across several countries, often giving existing buildings or districts new uses. He emphasised personal contact and maintained a financial reserve so projects could continue without stretching the company's balance sheet.

uncertainties.detail: Identity confidence is 93. The authoritative owner record supplies the exact Joop Punt-to-Three Point 4 relationship. Public interviews resolve the same alive Dutch North Holland cinema-and-property entrepreneur, and recent boating remarks align unusually closely with the vessel's Amsterdam-to-Stellendam pattern. No independent public source explicitly states the yacht's name or legal owner, so this residual gap is preserved and the bridge is not used outside identity resolution.

uncertainties.detail: A direct September 2017 interview gives Punt's age as 76, which narrows but does not uniquely determine a birth year without a birthday. Public sources consistently use Joop, but no strong source establishes whether it is his full legal given name or a Dutch call name. No birth date, birthplace or middle-name proposal is made.

Punt directly says he took over his father's established civil-works company and separately created substantial cinema, systems-construction and property ventures. This supports Mixed as the least-distorting classification, but the legal transfer instrument, inherited stake, seed capital and relative contribution of the family and founder-built components are not public. The biography therefore describes succession and creation without claiming a documented inheritance.

Direct and first-party sources identify Punt as the leader of Punt Beheer and current sources show the company remains active, but no current cap table or exact personal shareholding is public. Founder describes his creation of the principal cinema-and-property platform, not legal authorship of every group entity or the antecedent family contractor.

Focused searches across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok and personal-domain combinations produced no collision-safe personal account. Matching-name results lacked official cross-links or sufficient Punt Beheer anchors. The official Punt Beheer domain is proposed only as a Company Website. Forbes was checked separately and not found.

Commercial real estate is the principal current tag and Cinema exhibition is retained as a separate former-but-defining cohort because the cinema chain was a substantial wealth-producing operation rather than a property-side project. Although both catalogue entries share an industry-specialism dimension, they answer distinct click-through questions and are directly supported. Inactive property-development and shopping-centre concepts were not assigned, and no candidate was created.
